blocks.text: The log and control gateway allows you to control and forward traffic logs and operational messages to the Zscaler cloud. A default log and control gateway with a predefined primary and secondary proxy is automatically created.
Log and control gateways provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Give users the ability to control the Zscaler data centers used to forward the logs.
Allow users to choose the primary and backup Zscaler data centers that are used to forward the logs.

blocks.heading: About the Log and Control Gateway Page

blocks.text: On the Log and Control Gateway page (Zero Trust Cloud > Gateways > Log and Control Gateway), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
Add a log and control gateway.
View a list of all gateways. For each gateway, you can view:
Gateway Name: The name of the gateway. You can sort this column.
Primary Proxy: The primary proxy for the gateway.
Secondary Proxy: The secondary proxy for the gateway.
Description: Additional notes or information about the gateway.
Edit a log and control gateway.
Delete a log and control gateway.
You cannot delete the default log and control gateway.
